title: Session 8: SEO Tools and Google Analytics

questions.questionText: SEO tools help to:
options: Thoroughly investigate a website and give insights on keywords and backlinks
questions.correctAnswer: Thoroughly investigate a website and give insights on keywords and backlinks
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Thoroughly investigate a website and give insights on keywords and backlinks.

questions.questionText: SEO tools help maintain site health by:
questions.correctAnswer: Discovering areas of opportunity
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Discovering areas of opportunity.

questions.questionText: SEO tool reports can show issues such as:
options: Missing meta descriptions and page server errors
questions.correctAnswer: Missing meta descriptions and page server errors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Missing meta descriptions and page server errors.

questions.questionText: Live data on a site shows:
options: How many visitors are on the site right now
questions.correctAnswer: How many visitors are on the site right now
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) How many visitors are on the site right now.

questions.questionText: Conversion occurs when:
options: A user becomes a customer and transacts with the business
questions.correctAnswer: A user becomes a customer and transacts with the business
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A user becomes a customer and transacts with the business.

questions.questionText: Google Analytics is a tool to:
options: Track and analyze performance of a website or app
questions.correctAnswer: Track and analyze performance of a website or app
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Track and analyze performance of a website or app.

questions.questionText: Who can access Google Analytics?
questions.correctAnswer: Anyone with a Google account
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Anyone with a Google account.

questions.questionText: The paid version of Google Analytics is called:
questions.correctAnswer: Google Analytics 360
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Google Analytics 360.

questions.questionText: To get started with Analytics, click:
options: Start measuring on the Welcome page
questions.correctAnswer: Start measuring on the Welcome page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Start measuring on the Welcome page.

questions.questionText: In the account setup, it is recommended to use:
options: A business name as the account name
questions.correctAnswer: A business name as the account name
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A business name as the account name.

questions.questionText: In Google Analytics, a property is:
options: A website, mobile app or URL with a unique tracking ID
questions.correctAnswer: A website, mobile app or URL with a unique tracking ID
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A website, mobile app or URL with a unique tracking ID.

questions.questionText: The tracking code is used to:
options: Collect and organize data from the website
questions.correctAnswer: Collect and organize data from the website
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Collect and organize data from the website.

questions.questionText: Universal Analytics property was introduced in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 2012.

questions.questionText: GA4 property was introduced in:
questions.correctAnswer: October 2020
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) October 2020.

questions.questionText: GA4 uses which technology to provide smart insights?
questions.correctAnswer: Machine learning
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Machine learning.

questions.questionText: GA4 uses which ID to identify the data stream?
questions.correctAnswer: Measurement ID
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Measurement ID.

questions.questionText: Data streams are sources such as:
options: Website, Android app and iOS app
questions.correctAnswer: Website, Android app and iOS app
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Website, Android app and iOS app.

questions.questionText: A Web stream indicates that:
options: The source of data is the web
The source is a phone call
questions.correctAnswer: The source of data is the web
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The source of data is the web.

questions.questionText: Universal Analytics uses which ID to collect data?
questions.correctAnswer: Tracking ID
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Tracking ID.

questions.questionText: Where is the Analytics tracking code pasted?
options: After the <head> tag of every web page to be tracked
questions.correctAnswer: After the <head> tag of every web page to be tracked
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) After the <head> tag of every web page to be tracked.

questions.questionText: Where is Tracking Code found in Admin?
options: Property column > Tracking Info > Tracking Code
questions.correctAnswer: Property column > Tracking Info > Tracking Code
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Property column > Tracking Info > Tracking Code.

questions.questionText: Standard reports in Analytics appear:
options: On the left side of the dashboard
questions.correctAnswer: On the left side of the dashboard
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) On the left side of the dashboard.

questions.questionText: The standard reports are divided into:
options: Realtime, Audience, Acquisition, Behavior and Conversions
questions.correctAnswer: Realtime, Audience, Acquisition, Behavior and Conversions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Realtime, Audience, Acquisition, Behavior and Conversions.

questions.questionText: Realtime Overview data becomes available within:
options: Two seconds of a visitor hitting the site
questions.correctAnswer: Two seconds of a visitor hitting the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Two seconds of a visitor hitting the site.

questions.questionText: Realtime shows a graph of:
questions.correctAnswer: Pageviews per minute and second
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Pageviews per minute and second.

questions.questionText: Social traffic refers to:
options: Traffic from social networks and social media
questions.correctAnswer: Traffic from social networks and social media
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Traffic from social networks and social media.

questions.questionText: Referrals are:
options: Visits to the site from links that appear on other sites
questions.correctAnswer: Visits to the site from links that appear on other sites
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Visits to the site from links that appear on other sites.

questions.questionText: Audiences are:
questions.correctAnswer: Visitors grouped by certain attributes
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Visitors grouped by certain attributes.

questions.questionText: The Audience Overview report shows:
options: Number of visitors each day, device type and time on site
questions.correctAnswer: Number of visitors each day, device type and time on site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Number of visitors each day, device type and time on site.

questions.questionText: Audience data can be viewed by:
questions.correctAnswer: Language, city and country
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Language, city and country.

questions.questionText: A session is:
options: A group of user interactions with the site in a given time frame
questions.correctAnswer: A group of user interactions with the site in a given time frame
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A group of user interactions with the site in a given time frame.

questions.questionText: Pages per session shows:
options: The average number of pages viewed by each user per session
questions.correctAnswer: The average number of pages viewed by each user per session
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The average number of pages viewed by each user per session.

questions.questionText: New visitors are those who:
options: Visit the site for the first time
questions.correctAnswer: Visit the site for the first time
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Visit the site for the first time.

questions.questionText: Bounce rate in Analytics is:
options: The percentage of single-page visits where the visitor leaves
questions.correctAnswer: The percentage of single-page visits where the visitor leaves
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The percentage of single-page visits where the visitor leaves.

questions.questionText: The Acquisition Overview report tells:
options: Which channel brings the most visitors
questions.correctAnswer: Which channel brings the most visitors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Which channel brings the most visitors.

questions.questionText: A source in Acquisition is:
options: The last visited place of the visitor, such as a website
questions.correctAnswer: The last visited place of the visitor, such as a website
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The last visited place of the visitor, such as a website.

questions.questionText: A medium in Acquisition is:
options: The medium through which visitors get to the website
questions.correctAnswer: The medium through which visitors get to the website
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The medium through which visitors get to the website.

questions.questionText: Paid Search channel refers to:
options: Paid links, such as Google Ads, through which visitors come
questions.correctAnswer: Paid links, such as Google Ads, through which visitors come
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Paid links, such as Google Ads, through which visitors come.

questions.questionText: A Direct channel means visitors come by:
options: Typing the URL in the address bar or using a bookmark
questions.correctAnswer: Typing the URL in the address bar or using a bookmark
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Typing the URL in the address bar or using a bookmark.

questions.questionText: The Social channel refers to:
options: Social networking platforms through which visitors come
questions.correctAnswer: Social networking platforms through which visitors come
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Social networking platforms through which visitors come.

questions.questionText: Behavior Overview report shows:
options: Pageviews, unique pageviews, average time on page, bounce rate and exit rate
questions.correctAnswer: Pageviews, unique pageviews, average time on page, bounce rate and exit rate
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Pageviews, unique pageviews, average time on page, bounce rate and exit rate.

questions.questionText: Unique pageviews are:
options: The number of sessions during which a page is viewed
questions.correctAnswer: The number of sessions during which a page is viewed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The number of sessions during which a page is viewed.

questions.questionText: Exit rate is:
options: The percentage of the last visited page in a session
questions.correctAnswer: The percentage of the last visited page in a session
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The percentage of the last visited page in a session.

questions.questionText: A goal in Analytics is:
options: Any conversion that occurs on the site
questions.correctAnswer: Any conversion that occurs on the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Any conversion that occurs on the site.

questions.questionText: Which Conversion report analyses purchase activity?
questions.correctAnswer: Ecommerce
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Ecommerce.

questions.questionText: Ecommerce reports can show:
options: Number of transactions, average order value and conversion rate
questions.correctAnswer: Number of transactions, average order value and conversion rate
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Number of transactions, average order value and conversion rate.

questions.questionText: Multi-Channel Funnels reports help to:
options: Determine how marketing channels contribute to conversions
questions.correctAnswer: Determine how marketing channels contribute to conversions
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Determine how marketing channels contribute to conversions.

questions.questionText: Ahrefs SEO tools are popular among:
questions.correctAnswer: Marketing professionals
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Marketing professionals.

questions.questionText: To use Ahrefs paid tools, a project is set up by:
questions.correctAnswer: Verifying the domain
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Verifying the domain.

questions.questionText: Ahrefs Site Explorer provides information about:
options: Organic search traffic and backlink profile of any website or URL
questions.correctAnswer: Organic search traffic and backlink profile of any website or URL
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Organic search traffic and backlink profile of any website or URL.

questions.questionText: Which is a tool in Ahrefs Site Explorer?
questions.correctAnswer: Backlink checker
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Backlink checker.

questions.questionText: Organic traffic research in Ahrefs helps to:
options: Check how competitors rank for keywords and pages that bring the most traffic
questions.correctAnswer: Check how competitors rank for keywords and pages that bring the most traffic
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Check how competitors rank for keywords and pages that bring the most traffic.

questions.questionText: Paid traffic research in Ahrefs helps to:
options: Check if competitors are doing paid ads
questions.correctAnswer: Check if competitors are doing paid ads
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Check if competitors are doing paid ads.

questions.questionText: In Ahrefs, which report shows competing domains?
questions.correctAnswer: Organic search > Competing domains
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Organic search > Competing domains.

questions.questionText: In keyword reports, "KD" typically stands for:
questions.correctAnswer: Keyword Difficulty
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Keyword Difficulty.

questions.questionText: In keyword reports, "CPC" stands for:
questions.correctAnswer: Cost per click
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Cost per click.

questions.questionText: In keyword reports, "Volume" indicates:
questions.correctAnswer: Average monthly searches
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Average monthly searches.

questions.questionText: SEMrush Backlink Analytics can be used to:
options: Perform backlink analysis for a site
questions.correctAnswer: Perform backlink analysis for a site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Perform backlink analysis for a site.
